harambee.note: Community fundraising/self-help tradition; Kenyan national motto. Keep untranslated.

nyumba kumi.note: Community policing initiative (ten-household clusters); keep untranslated.

baraza.note: Public community meeting, often convened by a chief; keep untranslated.

matatu.note: Privately owned public-service minibus; keep untranslated.

M-Pesa.note: Safaricom mobile-money service; brand name, keep exact capitalization.

ugali.note: Stiff maize-meal staple food; keep untranslated.

sukuma wiki.note: Collard greens (literally 'push the week'); keep untranslated.

NHIF.note: National Hospital Insurance Fund (being replaced by SHA); keep acronym.

SHA.note: Social Health Authority, successor to NHIF (2024); keep acronym.

KCSE.note: Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education; keep acronym.

bursary.note: County/CDF education grant; commonly kept as 'bursary' in Swahili text.

huduma.note: 'Service' — as in Huduma Centre one-stop government service centres.

chief.note: Local administrator of a location; announcements often begin 'through the area chief'.

mama mboga.note: Informal vegetable vendor, usually a woman; keep untranslated.

bodaboda stage.note: Designated waiting/pickup point for motorcycle taxis.

sacco.note: Savings and credit co-operative society; keep untranslated.

unga.note: Maize flour (unga wa mahindi); central to food-price announcements.

El Niño.note: Climate phenomenon linked to heavy rains/flooding in Kenya; keep as-is.

long rains.note: March-May rainy season; standard Met Department term.

short rains.note: October-December rainy season; standard Met Department term.
